summary: AITX filed a routine Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing a press release titled "AITX's RAD Calls for Clear Boundaries in the Age of AI-Powered Security." The release, issued as the security industry gathers at GSX 2026, advocates for clearer guardrails on data generated by AI-powered security and license plate recognition systems. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report under Items 8.01 and 9.01, not a deal event. Watch for future operational or capital-markets disclosures.
